summary: Peabody Energy Corp filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of $225 million aggregate principal amount of 0.50% convertible senior notes due 2031, offered privately to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, settle June 2, 2026, with an underwriter option for an additional $25 million. Interest is payable semi-annually; conversion rights begin December 1, 2030, with settlement in cash, stock, or a combination. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation elements are present.
